metric_protocol: Each seed separately. Per-IID shared empirical ND reference from participating methods and selected three seeds; common scale/ref=(1.1)^5, no clipping. Stage1 uses3methods and final4methods are uniformly recomputed; no cross-reference absolute comparison.
q_bin_note: Nearest descriptive centers, not categorical policy actions. N=50 cannot produce q/N=1%; q<=15% is counted directly.
evaluation_aggregation: Within each IID mean over three seeds; equal-IID macro. Conditional-q means omit genuinely absent states and report counts.
training_aggregation: Counts over optimized training transitions; training and evaluation are separate domains.
source_and_load: Reused baseline and new searches on same desktop at different load epochs; new searches three pinned workers.
